notes: 1.16.0 (openhands-sdk 1.21.0) headless with LLM_BASE_URL: plain litellm→openai-python headers (the same OpenAI/Python user-agent and x-stainless-raw-response as Aider and other LiteLLM clients), so identity ('You are OpenHands agent, a helpful AI assistant…') and the 7-tool set carry the verdict; prompt_cache_key holds the conversation id and the request is non-streaming with max_completion_tokens. The system message is a list of two text parts: the static prompt and a dated skills/environment part. Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the --resume follow-up; no title or condenser side request before 80 events.
